description: This file defines a PHP trait named VueComponentPermissionTrait used for managing permissions in Vue components within the OrangeHRM Core plugin. It includes a method to set permissions based on user roles, highlighting its role in access control and permission management in the application.

methods.name: setPermissions
methods.description: Sets the permissions for a Vue component by retrieving the user role data and placing it into the context for use in the Vue frontend. Throws a LogicException if used outside the AbstractVueController context.
